title: Converge a VCF Operations maintenance schedule idempotently
prompt: Implement the exported Set-VcfOpsMaintenanceWindow function in src/VcfOps.MaintenanceWindow/VcfOps.MaintenanceWindow.psm1. The runner installs the genuine VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops PowerCLI module version 13.5.0.25380678 as an environment prerequisite; drive VCF Operations through Initialize-VcfOpsschedule, Initialize-VcfOpsmaintenanceschedule, Invoke-VcfOpsGetMaintenanceSchedules, Invoke-VcfOpsCreateMaintenanceSchedules, and Invoke-VcfOpsUpdateMaintenanceSchedules rather than a direct HTTP client. The fleet maintenance orchestrator restarts an interrupted plan from the top, so calling this function again with the same arguments must converge instead of leaving a second schedule behind. A schedule key is unique across the system and createMaintenanceSchedules answers HTTP 422 when the key is already taken, so read the schedule that currently holds Key before mutating anything. When no schedule holds the key, create it and let the server assign the identifier: the create request must not preassign an id. When a schedule holds the key and already matches the requested definition, send no write request at all. When it holds the key but the stored definition differs, update it in place carrying the identifier the server already assigned. Map DurationMinutes onto the schedule duration field. Only parameters the caller actually bound may reach the wire: unbound optional fields must be omitted from the JSON body entirely rather than sent as null, an empty string, an empty array, or a zero, and dayOfTheMonth, daysOfTheMonth, month, months, startDate, and weeksOfTheMonth must never be emitted. Treat an optional field the caller did not bind as drift when the stored schedule has a value for it, and compare DaysOfTheWeek as a set so that reordering the days is not a change. Return a PSCustomObject carrying Key, Id, and Action, where Action is Created, Updated, or Unchanged and Id is the server-assigned schedule identifier in all three cases. Keep the existing public function signature and module manifest compatible. Do not use Invoke-RestMethod, Invoke-WebRequest, WebClient, HttpClient, curl, or another direct HTTP client, and do not vendor, replace, or intercept the VMware prerequisite. The authoritative wire projection is docs/contract.json and its pinned specification provenance is docs/official_sources.json. The verifier drives the genuine SDK against a contract-pinned loopback VCF Operations mock, asserts the exact request wire shape and omission semantics, and never contacts a live VMware endpoint.
